heading: Qualifications, terms and conditions of service of Chairperson and Member
text: [1][2[9A. Selection, qualifications, conditions of service, allowances, etc.--- Notwithstanding anything contained in this Act, the qualifications, manner of selection, appointment, salaries and allowances, resignation, removal and other conditions of service and eligibility for reappointment of a Chairperson and Members of the Tribunal under this Act shall be governed by the provisions of the Tribunals Reforms Act, 2026.]]

amendment_history.footnote_text: 1. Ins. by Act 7 of 2017, s. 181 (w.e.f. 26-5-2017). 2. Subs by Act 17 of 2026, s. 18 and Sch. II for section 9A (w.e.f. 25-08-2026).
